Fire is the first magic. It's the magic of anger, of hunger, of the campfire that keeps the dark at bay. Every mage starts with fire, and most never stop.

But fire's just the beginning. Ice that freezes blood in the veins. Lightning that jumps from foe to foe like it's choosing favorites. Acid that doesn't just burn, it _unmakes._ Force magic that hits like a battering ram made of pure will. Illusions that make trained soldiers stab at shadows. The cold arithmetic of necromancy. The whisper that becomes a command. The body reshaped into something faster, harder, deadlier.

Arcane magic is the art of telling the universe to sit down and shut up, and making it listen. You don't ask. You don't pray. You _impose._

This chapter contains every arcane spell in the game: ten cantrips you know from the start, and thirty spell families that run Novice, Adept, and Master. Every spell card carries a Discipline, an action, a range, and an effect. A Novice active card prints its Weak, Standard, and Strong outcomes; its Adept and Master family members are separate cards with their own names and a single Effect line. Key the numbers to the damage budget (@sec-damage-budget), and cast. Where a card prints half of a value, round down.

_See @sec-chapter-magic-system for how spellcasting works._

#pagebreak()

== Arcane Cantrips

Cantrips are minor spells. The magic you learn before you learn _real_ magic. They don't require Disciplines, they don't cost anything to learn, and you can cast them as often as you like, at-will, every round, all day. Every arcane caster knows all of these.

They won't win a fight by themselves. But they'll start one, end one, or change the terms of one. Never underestimate a caster who knows exactly what their cantrips can do.

=== Arcane Mark (Cantrip)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Touch (Permanent until dispelled) · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* The mark is faint. Detection spells reveal it, but the image is blurry.

*Standard:* Clean, permanent mark. Visible on command, unmistakably yours.

*Strong:* The mark is flawless. You may also sense when any creature touches it within 100 feet for the next 24 hours.

=== Dancing Lights (Cantrip)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 60 ft (Concentration, up to 1 minute) · *Keywords:* Bane

*Weak:* Two dim orbs. Light radius halved. They flicker.

*Standard:* Four bright orbs or one glowing shape. Full control of movement.

*Strong:* The lights are dazzling. One creature of your choice within the light radius has Bane on its next attack.

=== Frost Touch (Cantrip)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Touch · *Keywords:* Bane

*Weak:* 1 cold damage. Liquid chills but doesn't freeze.

*Standard:* 3 cold damage. Liquid freezes solid.

*Strong:* 5 cold damage. Target's next physical action has Bane as cold numbs their limbs.

=== Ghost Sound (Cantrip)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft (Concentration, up to 1 minute) · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* One brief, obvious sound. Anyone listening gets a Reason check to recognize it as magical.

*Standard:* Sustained or repeating sounds. Believable enough to distract or mislead.

*Strong:* Complex audio, a full sentence in a recognizable voice, or a soundscape (approaching guards, a wolf pack circling).

=== Mage Hand (Cantrip)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft (Concentration, up to 1 minute) · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* The hand is clumsy. Fine manipulation fails. Objects may be dropped.

*Standard:* Precise control. The hand can turn keys, pour liquids, or lift up to 10 pounds.

*Strong:* The hand is preternaturally deft. It can pick pockets, disarm simple traps, or deliver a potion to an ally's lips mid-combat.

=== Prestidigitation (Cantrip)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 10 ft (Up to 1 hour) · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* One effect. It's crude, the sparks are dull, the cleaning is smeary.

*Standard:* Up to three simultaneous effects. Each works exactly as intended.

*Strong:* Your effects are especially vivid or lasting. The perfume lingers for hours. The sparks are bright enough to briefly distract. The cleaning removes stains that have been there for years.

=== Spark (Cantrip)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* The object smolders. It may catch fire after 1 round if left alone.

*Standard:* Immediate ignition. The object catches fire and burns normally.

*Strong:* The flame leaps. Adjacent flammable objects also catch fire.

=== Static Shock (Cantrip)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* 1 lightning damage. The target feels a tingle.

*Standard:* 3 lightning damage; +1 damage tier against metal armor.

*Strong:* 5 lightning damage. The spark chains to one additional target within 10 feet for half damage.

=== Acid Splash (Cantrip)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* 1 acid damage. The acid sizzles weakly.

*Standard:* 3 acid damage. Ignores 1 point of DR against objects.

*Strong:* 5 acid damage. The acid clings and keeps eating.

=== Whisper (Cantrip)
*Disciplines:* None · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 120 ft · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* The message is garbled. Key words may be lost.

*Standard:* Clear message. 25 words, perfectly delivered.

*Strong:* The message carries emotional weight, urgency, calm, menace. The target understands not just the words but the intent behind them.

== Arcane Spells

=== Ember Lance (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Fire · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Piercing, Burning

*Weak:* 2 fire damage.

*Standard:* 4 fire damage; the lance passes through to one target behind for 2 fire damage.

*Strong:* 6 fire damage; 4 fire damage to one target behind.

=== Brimstone Burst (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Fire · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 20-ft radius · *Keywords:* Burning

*Weak:* 4 fire damage to all in the radius (Agility or Dodge rank resists).

*Standard:* 6 fire damage to all.

*Strong:* 8 fire damage to all; the ground burns (Burning 4).

=== Wall of Cinders (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Fire · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30-ft wall · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* 4 fire damage to creatures passing through.

*Standard:* 6 fire damage to passers.

*Strong:* 8 fire damage to passers; ignites flammables.

=== Burning Volley (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Fire · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 60 ft · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* 2 fire damage, split across three lances.

*Standard:* 4 fire damage, split across three lances.

*Strong:* 6 fire damage, split across three lances.

=== Frostbite Shard (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Water · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Slowed, Frozen

*Weak:* 2 cold damage.

*Standard:* 4 cold damage; the target is Slowed 5 for 1 turn.

*Strong:* 6 cold damage; the target is Slowed 5.

=== Rime Storm (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Water · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 15-ft radius · *Keywords:* Slowed, Frozen

*Weak:* 4 cold damage (Agility or Dodge rank resists).

*Standard:* 6 cold damage; targets are Slowed 5.

*Strong:* 8 cold damage; targets are Slowed 5 for 2 rounds.

=== Glacial Prison (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Water · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Restrained, Frozen

*Weak:* 4 cold damage.

*Standard:* 6 cold damage; the target is Restrained (break: Standard Athletics, once per turn).

*Strong:* 8 cold damage; the target is Restrained for 2 rounds.

=== Storm Javelin (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Wind · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 60 ft · *Keywords:* Bane

*Weak:* 2 lightning damage.

*Standard:* 4 lightning damage; the target has Bane on its next attack.

*Strong:* 6 lightning damage; the target has Bane on its next 2 attacks; arcs to one adjacent target for half.

=== Forked Sky (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Wind · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* 4 lightning damage, split across three arcs.

*Standard:* 6 lightning damage, split across three arcs.

*Strong:* 8 lightning damage, split across three arcs.

=== Static Field (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Wind · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 10-ft radius · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* 4 lightning damage to all adjacent targets (Agility or Dodge rank resists).

*Standard:* 6 lightning damage to all adjacent.

*Strong:* 8 lightning damage to all adjacent; targets lose their Maneuver.

=== Corrosive Spit (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Earth · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* DR

*Weak:* 2 acid damage.

*Standard:* 4 acid damage; the target's DR is reduced by 1 for 1 turn.

*Strong:* 6 acid damage; the target's DR is reduced by 2.

=== Caustic Mist (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Earth · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 15-ft radius · *Keywords:* Bane

*Weak:* 4 acid damage (Agility or Dodge rank resists).

*Standard:* 6 acid damage; targets have Bane on sight.

*Strong:* 8 acid damage; targets have Bane on sight for 2 rounds; the mist lasts 2 rounds.

=== Venom Lance (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Plants · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Bane

*Weak:* 2 poison damage.

*Standard:* 4 poison damage; Fortitude check or Bane.

*Strong:* 6 poison damage; Fortitude check or lose Maneuver.

=== Tremor (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Earth · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 10-ft radius · *Keywords:* Prone

*Weak:* 4 bludgeoning damage (Agility or Dodge rank resists).

*Standard:* 6 bludgeoning damage; targets are Prone.

*Strong:* 8 bludgeoning damage; targets are Prone and lose their Maneuver.

=== Gust (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Wind · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Prone, Push

*Weak:* No damage; Push 5 ft.

*Standard:* Push 10 ft.

*Strong:* Push 15 ft; the target is Prone.

=== Wind Wall (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Wind · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30-ft wall · *Keywords:* Bane

*Weak:* Missile attacks through the wall have Bane.

*Standard:* Missile attacks through the wall are blocked for 1 round.

*Strong:* Missile attacks through the wall are blocked for 2 rounds, and attackers are pushed 5 ft.

=== Force Dart (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Energy · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 60 ft · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* 2 force damage; never misses (the tier is still rolled).

*Standard:* 4 force damage.

*Strong:* 6 force damage.

=== Force Wave (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Energy · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 15-ft cone · *Keywords:* Prone, Push

*Weak:* 4 force damage; Push 5 ft (Agility or Dodge rank resists).

*Standard:* 6 force damage; Push 10 ft.

*Strong:* 8 force damage; Push 15 ft; targets are Prone.

=== Ward of Iron (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Energy · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Reaction · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* DR

*Weak:* +1 DR against one attack.

*Standard:* +2 DR against one attack.

*Strong:* +3 DR against one attack; the attacker takes 2 damage and the ward reflects 3 damage.

=== Unseen Hand (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Energy · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Restrained

*Weak:* Move an object of up to 10 lb for 1 turn.

*Standard:* Move an object of up to 20 lb for 1 turn.

*Strong:* Move an object of up to 50 lb for 2 turns; can hold a creature still (Restrained).

=== Silver Tongue (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Mind · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Bane, Boon

*Weak:* The target has Bane against your social checks for 1 scene (Reason resists).

*Standard:* The target has Bane against your social checks for 2 scenes.

*Strong:* The target has Bane against your social checks and is friendly for 1 scene.

=== Daze (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Mind · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* The target loses its Maneuver (Reason resists).

*Standard:* The target loses its Action.

*Strong:* The target loses its Action and Maneuver.

=== Phantasmal Image (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Mind · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Bane

*Weak:* The illusion lasts 1 turn.

*Standard:* The illusion lasts 2 turns.

*Strong:* The illusion lasts 3 turns and also produces sound; those who fail a Reason check have Bane.

=== Fade (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Mind · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Boon

*Weak:* Boon on Stealth for 1 turn.

*Standard:* Boon on Stealth for 2 turns.

*Strong:* Boon on Stealth for 3 turns; you cannot be targeted by sight.

=== Mind Crown (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Mind · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft, 1 scene · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* The target follows one simple command (Reason resists).

*Standard:* The target follows two simple commands.

*Strong:* The target follows your commands for the full scene and cannot attempt its Reason resistance again.

=== Eldritch Sight (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Energy · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* Reveal 1 clue about magic.

*Standard:* Reveal 2 clues about magic.

*Strong:* Reveal 3 clues about magic and identify any magical effect; the sight lasts 1 scene.

=== Flicker Step (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Energy · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Maneuver · *Range:* Self · *Keywords:* Boon, Bane

*Weak:* Teleport 5 ft.

*Standard:* Teleport 15 ft.

*Strong:* Teleport 30 ft; Boon on your next attack, and Bane on attacks against you for 1 turn.

=== Soul Drain (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 1 Energy · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* None

*Weak:* 2 necrotic damage; heal half the damage.

*Standard:* 4 necrotic damage; heal half the damage.

*Strong:* 6 necrotic damage; heal 3; slay at 0 HP.

=== March of Bones (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Energy · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* 30 ft · *Keywords:* Boon

*Weak:* Raise 1 skeleton for 1 scene.

*Standard:* Raise 2 skeletons for 1 scene.

*Strong:* Raise 3 skeletons for 1 hour.

=== Touch of the Grave (Arcane Spell)
*Disciplines:* 2 Energy · *Kit:* focus:arcane · *Action:* Action · *Range:* Touch · *Keywords:* Unconscious

*Weak:* 4 necrotic damage.

*Standard:* 6 necrotic damage; Fortitude check or Unconscious.

*Strong:* 8 necrotic damage; Fortitude check or die at 0 HP.
